newsitem.title: JAPAN: Idemitsu's Chiba topper turnaround to start Apr 30.
newsitem.headline: Idemitsu's Chiba topper turnaround to start Apr 30.

text.p: Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd said on Wednesday it will close its 250,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit at its Chiba refinery from April 30 to May 29 for routine maintenance work.
Idemitsu Kosan will also shut its secondary refining facilities for maintenance checks around the same period, a company spokesman said.

The Chiba plant has a 64,000 bpd vacuum distillation unit, a 42,000 bpd catalytic cracker, a 17,000 bpd catalytic reformer, a 43,000 bpd naphtha desulphuriser, a 113,000 bpd gas oil and kerosene desulphuriser, a 40,000 bpd direct desulphuriser and a 39,000 bpd indirect desulphuriser.
Idemitsu's 140,000 bpd Hyogo refinery is due to close for maintenance work for about a month from late August.
The refiner's Hokkaido, Aichi and Tokuyama refineries, which were closed for maintenance checks last year, will operate normally throughout this year.
Japanese refineries usually undergo major turnaround periods every other year.
